title: Raspberry Pi nginx Access Logs
description: Trafico HTTP de nginx (raspberrypi-dev/prod) y Traefik (traefik-v2), rediseñado: resumen ejecutivo, rankings agregados por rango (no series por intervalo), tabla de eventos individuales, y paneles de seguridad/errores.

panels.title: Solicitudes Totales

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="nginx-access", host=~"$host", method=~"$method", http_cf_ipcountry=~"$country|"} | regexp `^(?P<remote_addr>\S+) - (?P<remote_user>\S+) \[(?P<time_local>[^\]]+)\] "(?P<method>\S+) (?P<request>[^ ]+) (?P<protocol>[^"]+)" (?P<status>\d{3}) (?P<body_bytes_sent>\d+) "(?P<http_referer>[^"]*)" "(?P<http_user_agent>[^"]*)"(?: "(?P<host_header>[^"]*)" "(?P<server_name>[^"]*)" "(?P<scheme>[^"]*)" "(?P<request_uri>[^"]*)" "(?P<request_time>[^"]*)" "(?P<upstream_addr>[^"]*)" "(?P<upstream_status>[^"]*)" "(?P<upstream_response_time>[^"]*)" "(?P<http_x_forwarded_for>[^"]*)" "(?P<http_cf_connecting_ip>[^"]*)" "(?P<http_cf_ray>[^"]*)"(?: "(?P<http_cf_ipcountry>[^"]*)")?)?$` | label_format real_ip=`{{if and .http_cf_connecting_ip (ne .http_cf_connecting_ip "-")}}{{.http_cf_connecting_ip}}{{else if and .http_x_forwarded_for (ne .http_x_forwarded_for "-")}}{{.http_x_forwarded_for}}{{else}}{{.remote_addr}}{{end}}` | real_ip =~ "$client_ip" | status=~"$status_class"[$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({namespace="traefik-v2", container="traefik"} |= "RouterName" | regexp `(?P<jsonpart>\{.*)` | line_format `{{ .jsonpart }}` | json router="RouterName", svc="ServiceName", req_method="RequestMethod", path="RequestPath", req_status="DownstreamStatus", req_host="RequestHost", real_ip="ClientHost", ua=`["request_User-Agent"]`, country=`["request_Cf-Ipcountry"]`, resp_size="DownstreamContentSize", duration_ns="Duration" | router !~ "$exclude_monitoring_router_regex" | path !~ "$exclude_monitoring_request_regex" | req_method=~"$method" | real_ip =~ "$client_ip" | req_status=~"$status_class" | country=~"$country|"[$__range]))
